b75c65253192db22330001ef0531188155fc2cbd: A resort on a human scale, Campo Felice focuses on the warmth of its welcome and its proximity rather than on impressive figures. Its 31 km of runs are perfectly suited to a 3 to 4 day stay, especially for families or for skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. Campo Felice's family reputation is well earned: dedicated beginner areas, well-groomed green runs and a friendly atmosphere at the foot of the lifts. It is one of the most reassuring resorts in the Apennines for getting started on skis with children. Campo Felice's modest altitude, with a base at 1411 m and a summit at 1916 m, makes it sensitive to climate variations. January and February remain the safest months for optimal snow cover. Outside this window, checking the snow reports before setting off is strongly recommended. The 45€ day lift pass places Campo Felice in the mid-range category on price: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short: Campo Felice doesn't compete with the ski giants and doesn't pretend to. It is an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
